quality_gate.numeric_promotion_policy: Measured promotion requires direct parse/readback from an authoritative official facility-level annual numeric dataset. The EEA July 2026 listing and distribution identity remain verified, but the actual facility-level downloadable asset is unresolved, so Part42 annual values remain candidate-only.
quality_gate.candidate_confidence_rule: 99 requires official UK installation identity plus unique target-period facility/operator continuity and a uniquely attributable EUTL annual series.
quality_gate.west_burton_a_resolution: Official NIM identifies GB-EA-ETCO2-0159 as EDF Energy (West Burton Power) Limited / West Burton Power Station. Official EA/EDF sources distinguish West Burton A coal from West Burton B CCGT. In the linked EUTL object, account 97220 runs from 2005 and aligns with A, while 97223 starts in 2012 and was already resolved to B; therefore 97220 target-year values are attributable to West Burton A.
quality_gate.indian_queens_resolution: Official UK NIM identifies GB-EA-ETCO2-0001 Indian Queens Power Ltd. Environment Agency identifies Indian Queens Peak Power Facility under EPR/SP3833LF, ENGIE documents the 2017 sale of the same oil-fired peaking plant, and the linked EUTL object uniquely maps account 96869 to Indian Queens.
